detachedPrompts.title: KC hero translation FR
detachedPrompts.content:
Translate this element/paragraph

Small Books, Wide Worlds.

Children's literature, chosen to inspire curiosity and wonder.

KidsCorner is a treasure trove of children's and tween books chosen for their richness, character, and meaningful storytelling. Stories that invite thought, imagination, and discovery.

Here, stories create new worlds and quietly open the way ahead.

from Enlgish to French, being careful to know when to translate literally and when to adapt the words and sentences to the french culture, audience, online users, and market. Keep the style, the colours, the bolds, the regular, the italic, the overall structure and uses of design in the paragraph/hero element. Nothing else must change. Update the local js french translation and main translation file to be able to visualise, save and push modifications, and keep them for the future.
